Action Panel UI Variants

Variant 1: The Sleek Horizontal Toolbar (Recommended)

Removes the bulky left panel and introduces a high-end, frosted-glass floating toolbar at the top center. Clean icons with tooltips provide an unobstructed, premium viewing experience.

Variant 2: The Expanding Icon Sidebar

Keeps the controls on the left but minimizes them into an ultra-thin column of icons. It elegantly slides out to reveal text labels when hovered over.

Variant 3: Segmented Controls & FAB

Splits the controls up: View modes become a sleek iOS-style segmented toggle at the top, while "Upload Photo" becomes a prominent floating action button in the bottom right corner.
